requirements.title: Live desktop overlay
requirements.contract: Display annotation ink above normal desktop applications without capturing or freezing their content. The desktop underneath must keep updating. Fullscreen, Spaces, and compositor guarantees are separately certified.

requirements.title: Draw mode
requirements.contract: In Draw mode, the canvas receives pointer input across its entire selected output, including visually transparent pixels. Pointer events used to draw must not activate controls underneath.

requirements.title: True pass-through
requirements.contract: In PassThrough mode, ink remains visible while ordinary pointer, wheel, and keyboard interaction belongs to underlying applications. Do not implement this by forwarding or synthesizing input.

requirements.title: Hide without clearing
requirements.contract: Hidden mode removes canvas and toolbar visibility and input interception while retaining committed annotations in memory. Startup begins Hidden.

requirements.title: Activation and escape
requirements.contract: Provide configurable ToggleDraw and EmergencyHide actions, registration/conflict feedback, a non-tray recovery path, and a CLI control command. Wayland may require the GlobalShortcuts portal or a user-configured compositor shortcut.

requirements.title: Toolbar isolation
requirements.contract: Provide a compact floating toolbar. Its pointer events never create strokes. It is a separate platform surface or a backend-proven input region, not an imaginary clickable button on an entirely click-through surface.

requirements.title: Pen and highlighter
requirements.contract: Support freehand pen and highlighter, configurable color, width in logical units, and opacity. A dot is a valid pen gesture; a canceled gesture is not an undoable document edit.

requirements.title: Basic shapes
requirements.contract: Support line, single-ended arrow, rectangle, and ellipse with a live preview. One completed drag creates one object and one history entry.

requirements.title: Object eraser
requirements.contract: Erase whole annotation objects intersecting the eraser gesture. An eraser drag is one undoable transaction; it never modifies another application or captured background pixels.

requirements.title: Undo, redo, and clear
requirements.contract: Undo/redo act on completed user actions, not pointer samples. Clear is undoable. A new committed edit clears the redo branch; a no-op does not.

requirements.title: Output-local document
requirements.contract: Own annotations by an application OutputId and store output-local logical coordinates. One selected output is sufficient for MVP, but output switching must preserve each document.

requirements.title: Coordinate correctness
requirements.contract: Convert native input, render pixels, output rotation, and display scaling at the backend boundary. Test fractional and mixed DPI. Do not assume a universal Wayland global desktop coordinate space.

requirements.title: Capabilities and honest fallback
requirements.contract: Probe and report overlay, pass-through, shortcut, focus, and output capabilities. Unknown is not Supported. A limited GNOME/windowed fallback must never be advertised as full live-overlay parity.

requirements.title: Minimal privileges
requirements.contract: Basic overlay drawing must not depend on screenshot permission, root, administrator elevation, raw input devices, screen recording, or system-wide keystroke monitoring. Do not bypass operating-system security boundaries.

requirements.title: Explicit local document files
requirements.contract: Save/load an explicit versioned vector document locally. Loading is atomic from the user perspective: validation failure leaves the existing document intact. Saving annotations does not capture the desktop.

requirements.title: Privacy defaults
requirements.contract: No accounts, cloud upload, analytics, content logging, or automatic screenshot retention. Vector autosave is off by default for the MVP. Explicit file exports are user-directed.

requirements.title: Safe file and settings handling
requirements.contract: Validate document/settings sizes and numeric values. Use same-directory temporary writes and platform-appropriate atomic replacement, retaining the previous valid file after failure.

requirements.title: Gesture and transition safety
requirements.contract: Cancel transient drawing on EmergencyHide, focus/input cancellation, or output loss. During a mode transition no already-held pointer button may leak into an accidental underlying click or start a new stroke.

requirements.title: Fault recovery
requirements.contract: On recoverable surface, GPU, or mode-application failure, withdraw interactive overlays before reporting the fault. On backend disconnect clean up resources. Do not show PassThrough as effective until its native transition completes.

requirements.title: Settings and diagnostics
requirements.contract: Persist validated tool preferences and user-approved shortcut bindings. Provide a doctor command with backend, versions, capabilities, and failure reasons, without document text or desktop pixels.

requirements.title: Simultaneous multiple outputs
requirements.contract: Support multiple active per-output surfaces. A stroke cannot jump coordinates between outputs; crossing an output boundary ends the current stroke. A new press begins a new stroke on the other output.

requirements.title: Hotplug and session lifecycle
requirements.contract: Handle output removal, reconnection, scale/rotation changes, lock/unlock, suspend/resume, and workspace changes without invisible input-blocking surfaces or silent annotation loss.

requirements.title: Text and editing
requirements.contract: Add Unicode text with IME/preedit support, selection/move/delete, and style editing. Text edit keyboard focus is explicit and released on leaving the editor.

requirements.title: Annotation-only export
requirements.contract: Export transparent PNG and SVG from the vector scene without reading desktop content. Clearly label these as ink-only exports, not screenshots.

requirements.title: Distribution and verification
requirements.contract: Package for Windows, macOS, and selected Linux environments. Every supported environment has native acceptance evidence; a successful cross-compilation alone is insufficient.

requirements.title: Capture and freeze
requirements.contract: Add explicit user-initiated screenshot capture and freeze as separate capabilities. Permission denial/cancellation must leave live overlay usable; freeze blocks underlying interaction until dismissed.

requirements.title: Screenshot composite export
requirements.contract: Capture the selected output, then composite committed annotations exactly once, excluding app controls and avoiding recursive self-capture. Treat captured pixels as sensitive and ephemeral by default.

requirements.title: Presenter extras
requirements.contract: Consider whiteboard/blackboard, fading laser in Draw mode, spotlight, and pressure input after their platform and interaction contracts exist. Passive system-wide cursor effects are a separate opt-in project.

requirements.title: Drawing responsiveness
requirements.contract: Proposed target on a documented 1080p/60 Hz reference machine: p95 input-dispatch-to-render-submit <= 16.7 ms for the benchmark scene. Measure input-to-photon separately; submission is not display latency.

requirements.title: Idle efficiency
requirements.contract: When Hidden or displaying unchanged ink with no animation, schedule no continuous redraw loop. Proposed Hidden CPU target: < 1% of one logical core averaged over 60 seconds on a recorded reference machine.

requirements.title: Responsiveness and memory bounds
requirements.contract: No blocking capture, disk, or portal calls in the GUI event loop. Bound input queues, geometry caches, object count, and undo history; report truncation or limits rather than silently growing without bound.

requirements.title: Testable core
requirements.contract: The domain and command reducer have no OS, window, GPU, or portal dependencies. Their tests run headlessly and deterministically with injected clocks/IDs.

requirements.title: Failure visibility
requirements.contract: Typed errors distinguish Unsupported, PermissionDenied, ShortcutConflict, Disconnected, SurfaceLost, and InvalidData. Unsupported native operations must not return fake success.

requirements.title: Accessible controls
requirements.contract: All toolbar actions have labels, keyboard navigation, visible focus, and a non-color-only selected state. Verify platform accessibility output; egui selection alone is not evidence of conformance.

requirements.title: Traceable development
requirements.contract: Every implementation change references requirement IDs, scenario IDs, and a task. Tests, evidence, changed assumptions, and remaining gaps are recorded before a task is marked verified.

requirements.title: Dependency and release hygiene
requirements.contract: Pin a compatible Rust toolchain/dependency set during implementation, commit Cargo.lock, review unsafe FFI, audit licenses/dependencies, and record platform signing/package checks. No guessed version compatibility.
